question: Should ClawHub adopt this 30-day durable official-catalog delta contract now as the maintained foundation for the RFC-linked signed query/change transport?
rationale: The patch creates a new persisted protocol boundary and exported schema vocabulary; correctness tests do not establish that this is the product contract maintainers want to support long term.

options.title: Sponsor the durable foundation
options.body: Approve the contract after its retention/reset behavior is recorded in `specs/` and real Convex behavior is demonstrated.

options.title: Defer to a narrower transport design
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers choose a final catalog-distribution contract together with the signed transport surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the durable foundation
recommendation.body: Approve the contract after its retention/reset behavior is recorded in `specs/` and real Convex behavior is demonstrated.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed author across the linked feed-stack proposal and can clarify the contract boundaries for maintainer sponsorship.
